$comment: Test vectors for the inbox hash, observed from a RUNNING auth-callout.
The hash is computed independently by the callout (to mint the subscribe permission) and by
every client (to pick its inbox), with no channel between them. When they disagree the symptom
is a request that times out with no error anywhere the caller can see, and the violation is
logged by the NATS server. These values pin the real behaviour rather than one implementation's
opinion of it, which is why they were captured from a live callout and not computed here.
algorithm: lowercase(base32(sha256(userId))[0..16]), RFC 4648 alphabet, no padding.

vectors.note: a person (roles: admin, user), observed from the dev callout
a machine user (role: internal-app), observed from the dev callout
